responsibility: Implements GCC’s debug-counter runtime used to selectively enable or suppress individual optimization actions for bug isolation via -fdbg-cnt. It owns the counter name-to-enum mapping generated from dbgcnt.def, per-counter execution counts, interval-based limit state, option parsing for counter/range specifications, overlap checking and diagnostics, and the logic that returns true or false from dbg_cnt as passes probe whether a transformation instance should proceed; it also reports limit hits to stderr and the active dump file and can list all counters with their configured ranges.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable implementation of the dbgcnt group: it builds the name-to-counter table from dbgcnt.def, stores counts and configured intervals, parses -fdbg-cnt settings, and answers dbg_cnt queries at runtime. Unlike dbgcnt.def, which only lists counter names, and dbgcnt.h, which only exposes the enum and API, this file owns the mutable state and behavior.
